hazards.evidence: Shoes, a brown leather duffel/handbag, and additional footwear are on the carpet at the side of the bed, directly in the transfer/walker path.
The bag and shoes sit in the open floor area between the doorway and the bed, narrowing the clear walking path a walker user would take through the room.

The only bedside lamp is on the far side of the bed by the window; the near side of the bed (the side with floor space to stand with a walker) has no reachable light, and the only other light is a low night-light by the door.
The bedspread/quilt and bed skirt hang down to the floor along the side of the bed, which can catch walker legs or feet during transfers.
